info.title: PII Guard
info.description: Privacy firewall for AI agents: reversible PII masking. This is the public, read-only reference for the OpenAI-compatible gateway and the native masking routes. Guide, authentication and examples: https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/api.md. Every example is fictional.

tags.name: Gateway
tags.description: OpenAI-compatible routes. Point an OpenAI SDK at the guard's `/v1` base URL: the guard masks the request, calls the configured upstream and restores the placeholders in the answer, streamed or not. A hosted project endpoint serves the same routes under `/e/{endpoint_id}/v1` with an endpoint key.

tags.name: Masking
tags.description: Native routes: detect, mask with reversible placeholders, and restore. Not available to endpoint keys.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Vault sessions hold the placeholder mapping (sliding TTL, process memory). Pre-load values the application already knows are sensitive.

tags.name: Endpoint keys
tags.description: Issue, list and revoke the `pg_ep_` keys of a project endpoint. Owner only: on the hosted service a signed-in Google session, self-hosted the API token. An endpoint key cannot call these routes.

post.description: Mask the request, send it to the upstream, restore the placeholders in the answer. Text the guard finds is replaced with keyed placeholders (`[[PERSON_7f3a]]`); the upstream only ever sees those. Fail closed: on any error nothing is forwarded and no partially masked text is returned. A 200 stream can still end with an `error` event; a complete one ends with `data: [DONE]`.

post.summary: Replace personal data with reversible placeholders
post.description:
Detect personal data and replace each ``mask``-policy span with a vault placeholder.

``keep`` spans stay in place and are counted in ``kept``; any ``block`` span refuses the
request (422 ``blocked_entity``). The session's known values are masked on top of the
configured detectors, even for a ``keep`` type. Fail closed: on any error the body carries
no text, and a session this request created is dropped again.

post.summary: Restore the original values behind placeholders
post.description:
Replace every placeholder the session issued with its original value.

Tokens shaped like a placeholder but unknown to the session are reported in
``unresolved`` and left in place. Unknown or expired session: 404 ``not_found``.
Restoring more than ``PII_GUARD_UNMASK_MAX_RESTORED_CHARS`` characters of original values:
413 ``unmask_output_too_large``, nothing returned (LAB-1350).

A session a gateway request bound to a client identity (LAB-1565) restores only for that
identity (LAB-1580): a different ``Authorization`` value, or none for a credentialed
owner, gets the same 404 as a missing session. Unbound sessions (``/v1/mask``) and
anonymous-owned ones restore as before; unmasking never binds.

post.summary: Detect personal data without masking it
post.description:
Detect without masking. Every span carries its type's policy; ``block`` spans are
reported here, not refused (nothing leaves the guard).

With ``session_id`` the session's known values are merged in as ``/v1/mask`` does
(``detector: "known"``). The vault is only resolved then, so analyze without a session
needs no tenant key. Nothing is stored and no session is created; an unknown or expired
session is a 404. Known spans of a ``keep`` type report ``mask``: ``/v1/mask`` masks them.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to analyse. Offsets in the response are code-point indices into it.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the text (`hu`, `en`, `de`, ...). Defaults to `PII_GUARD_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE` (`hu`).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Optional vault session (1-128 characters, as on `/v1/mask`) whose pre-loaded known values are merged in (`detector: "known"`). Unknown or expired: 404 `not_found`. Never creates a session.

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description: Text to scan for personal data. Nothing is masked or stored.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: Spans sorted by `start`, after the resolver merged overlaps. The raw text of a span is not returned: slice `text` with `start`/`end`.

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description: Every detected span, `keep` and `block` ones included: analyze never refuses.

known_values.title: Known Values
known_values.description: Values to pre-load. At most `PII_GUARD_KNOWN_VALUES_MAX` (1000) per session; duplicates are ignored.

CreateSessionRequest.title: CreateSessionRequest
CreateSessionRequest.description: Optional body of ``POST /v1/sessions``: known values to pre-load.

EndpointKey.title: EndpointKey
EndpointKey.description: Endpoint key metadata. The raw key is never stored or returned again.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code (see the response's examples).

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation. Never echoes request text, values, keys or session ids: it names field locations, entity types or counts instead.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: What went wrong: a stable code and a message that never contains request content.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
The body of every non-2xx response, including validation errors and unknown routes.

Fail closed: an error body never carries masked, partially masked or input text.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many spans of that type were left in place.

KeptEntity.title: KeptEntity
KeptEntity.description: Detected but left in place by a ``keep`` policy. Type and count only, never values.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value, at least 3 non-space characters and at most `PII_GUARD_KNOWN_VALUES_MAX_LENGTH` (256). Matched case- and whitespace-insensitively, whole words, inflected forms included. Never logged or echoed.

entity_type.title: Entity Type
entity_type.description: A text entity type (`PERSON`, `ID_DOCUMENT`, ...); visual types are refused.

KnownValueIn.title: KnownValueIn
KnownValueIn.description: A value the application already knows is sensitive, with its entity type.

known_values.title: Known Values
known_values.description: Values to pre-load. At most `PII_GUARD_KNOWN_VALUES_MAX` (1000) per session; duplicates are ignored.

KnownValuesRequest.title: KnownValuesRequest
KnownValuesRequest.description: Known values to add to an existing session.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The vault session the values are stored on.

added.title: Added
added.description: New values this request added (duplicates excluded).

total.title: Total
total.description: Known values the session now holds.

KnownValuesResponse.title: KnownValuesResponse
KnownValuesResponse.description: Counts only: ``added`` new values (duplicates are ignored), ``total`` in the session.

entity_type.title: Entity Type
entity_type.description: The entity type it stands for.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many occurrences this call replaced with it.

MaskEntity.title: MaskEntity
MaskEntity.description: One distinct placeholder this call issued or reused. Never the original value.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the text (`hu`, `en`, `de`, ...). Defaults to `PII_GUARD_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE` (`hu`).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Vault session to mask in (1-128 characters). Omitted or `null`: a new session is created and returned. An existing id reuses its mapping, so the same value keeps the same placeholder across calls. Unknown or expired: 404 `not_found`.

MaskRequest.title: MaskRequest
MaskRequest.description: Text to mask, and the vault session whose placeholders to use.

masked_text.title: Masked Text
masked_text.description: The text with every `mask`-policy span replaced by its placeholder.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The vault session holding the mapping: the one sent, or a new one.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Each distinct placeholder once, with its replacement count.

kept.title: Kept
kept.description: Spans of `keep` types left in place, by type and count, sorted by type: no values, no offsets.

MaskResponse.title: MaskResponse
MaskResponse.description: The masked text and the session that can restore it (``/v1/unmask``).

NameRequest.title: NameRequest
NameRequest.description: A display name visible only to the configuration owner.

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description:
What happens to an entity type: ``mask`` it, ``keep`` it in place, or ``block`` the
request.

start.title: Start
start.description: Code-point offset of the span in `text`, inclusive.

end.title: End
end.description: Code-point offset of the span in `text`, exclusive.

detector.title: Detector
detector.description: Registry name of the detector that found it (`rules`, `ner`, `llm`, `known`).

subtype.title: Subtype
subtype.description: Which shape of the type the rule matched, e.g. `github_token`, `url_password` or `assignment` for `SECRET` (docs/contracts.md). Left out when the detector sets none. Names a rule, never a value.

policy.description: The type's effective policy. Known values report `mask` even for a `keep` type, because `/v1/mask` masks them.

PublicSpan.title: PublicSpan
PublicSpan.description: A span without its raw value (``Span.to_public_dict()``) plus its type's policy.

text.title: Text
text.description: Text with placeholders (`[[TYPE_id]]`), e.g. a model's answer.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The vault session the placeholders belong to (1-128 characters). Unknown or expired: 404 `not_found`.

UnmaskRequest.title: UnmaskRequest
UnmaskRequest.description: Text carrying placeholders, and the session that issued them.

text.title: Text
text.description: The re-identified text. Unresolved tokens are left in it as they are.

unresolved.title: Unresolved
unresolved.description: Placeholder-shaped tokens that aren't in the session mapping (invented or mangled by the model), once each, in order of first appearance.

UnmaskResponse.title: UnmaskResponse
UnmaskResponse.description: The text with every placeholder of the session restored.

apiToken.description: Self-hosted: the server's `PII_GUARD_API_TOKEN` (no authentication when it is unset; keep that server on loopback). Hosted: a 24-hour guard API key (`pg_...`) from the console. Also accepted as `X-PII-Guard-Token`. Never an upstream provider key.

endpointKey.description: A project endpoint key (`pg_ep_...`), shown once when issued. Valid only on its own `/e/{endpoint_id}/v1/chat/completions`, `/responses` and `/models`.
